Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ تَعَرَّضَ لَكَ فِيْ هٰذَا اللَّيْلِ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ
Translation: My God, in this night those who seek You have come forward
And those with intentions have set their aims toward You
And those who seek have hoped for Your grace and kindness

Arabic text: وَلَكَ فِيْ هٰذَا اللَّيْلِ نَفَحَاتٌ وَجَوَائِزُ
Translation: And for You in this night are gifts and prizes
And presents and grants

Arabic text: تَمُنُّ بِهَا عَلٰى مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
Translation: Which You bestow upon whomever You wish from Your servants

Arabic text: وَتَمْنَعُهَا مَنْ لَمْ تَسْبِقْ لَهُ الْعِنَايَةُ مِنْكَ
Translation: And You withhold from those who have not received Your prior care

Arabic text: وَهَا أَنَا ذَا عُبَيْدُكَ الْفَقِيرُ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And here I am, Your humble servant, in need of You
Hoping for Your grace and kindness

Arabic text: فَإِنْ كُنْتَ يَا مَوْلَايَ تَفَضَّلْتَ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ عَلٰى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: If You, O my Master, have bestowed favor in this night upon anyone of Your creation
And granted them a portion of Your kindness

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Then send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
The good, the pure, the virtuous, the excellent
And be generous to me with Your bounty and kindness
O Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ
Translation: And may Allah bless Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets
And his pure family
And grant them abundant peace
Indeed, Allah is Praiseworthy and Glorious
O Allah, I call upon You as You have commanded
So respond to me as You have promised
Indeed, You never break Your promise
